Name: C2H_MAGIC
Semantics: Constant ASCII C2H1 page identity for a conforming G2B build.
Clear_Rule: Constant; restored by hard reset.

Name: ABI_VERSION
Semantics: Contract-negotiation ABI version 1.0 with major in bits 31:16 and minor in bits 15:0; record headers independently use record_version 0x00004101.
Clear_Rule: Constant; restored by hard reset.

Name: CAPABILITIES
Semantics: Supported bits 4:0 are all one; implemented-this-build bits 19 17 and 16 are one; bit 18 and all reserved bits are zero.
Clear_Rule: Constant for conforming G2B build.

Name: CAPABILITIES.C2H_SUPPORTED
Semantics: Product architecture supports application C2H.
Clear_Rule: Constant.

Name: CAPABILITIES.RECORD_ABI_V1_SUPPORTED
Semantics: AHD_C2H_TRANSPORT_ABI_V1 is supported.
Clear_Rule: Constant.

Name: CAPABILITIES.ONE_CHANNEL_SUPPORTED
Semantics: Logical channel 0 operation is supported.
Clear_Rule: Constant.

Name: CAPABILITIES.TWO_CHANNEL_ABI_CAPABLE
Semantics: ABI represents channels 0 and 1; this is not an implementation claim.
Clear_Rule: Constant.

Name: CAPABILITIES.GEN2_CAPABLE
Semantics: Accepted endpoint configuration is Gen2-capable.
Clear_Rule: Constant.

Name: CAPABILITIES.RESERVED_ZERO_LOW
Semantics: Reserved; reads zero and writes are ignored.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: CAPABILITIES.C2H_IMPLEMENTED_THIS_BUILD
Semantics: The conforming G2B build contains the C2H transport path.
Clear_Rule: Constant for build.

Name: CAPABILITIES.ONE_CHANNEL_IMPLEMENTED_THIS_BUILD
Semantics: Logical channel 0 data plane is implemented in the conforming G2B build.
Clear_Rule: Constant for build.

Name: CAPABILITIES.TWO_CHANNEL_IMPLEMENTED_THIS_BUILD
Semantics: Two-channel data plane and scheduler are not implemented.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: CAPABILITIES.GEN2_CONFIGURED_THIS_BUILD
Semantics: Build uses the accepted Gen2 endpoint configuration.
Clear_Rule: Constant for build.

Name: CAPABILITIES.RESERVED_ZERO_HIGH
Semantics: Reserved; reads zero and writes are ignored.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: CONTROL.ENABLE_C2H
Semantics: Stored enable request; admission additionally requires source ready and locked reset idle no fatal error and a writable slot. Stable-data request/ack applies the gate in the source domain before AXI BVALID and stored readback update. Disable acknowledgement prevents later old-enable allocations; an existing FILLING attempt may finish and drain. A write of 1 while FATAL_ERROR=1 is ignored and stored enable remains 0.
Clock_Domain: axi_aclk control through acknowledged stable-data mailbox to source admission gate
Clear_Rule: Host writes 0; fatal error; RESET_STREAM_STATE; FPGA configuration or PCIe/axi hard reset. Fatal/stream reset also clear the applied gate through the defined handshake.

Name: CONTROL.RESET_C2H_STATS
Semantics: Atomic statistics-reset command. Legal only when ENABLE_C2H=0 C2H_ACTIVE=0 RING_EMPTY=1 STREAM_RESET_BUSY=0 and SNAPSHOT_BUSY=0; otherwise ignored and sets TRANSPORT_ERROR with cause STATS_RESET_REJECTED. A busy reset or snapshot is neither canceled nor altered by the rejected command. If simultaneously accepted with RESET_STREAM_STATE the statistics clear is applied first. A later standalone non-hard reset waits behind the clear; hard reset dominates and may abort the write.
Clock_Domain: axi_aclk with acknowledged all-domain counter-clear mailboxes
Clear_Rule: Pulse has no stored state. AXI BVALID waits for every clear acknowledgement and atomic shadow clear. An accepted command clears MMIO numeric counters sequence shadows snapshot generation and LAST_ERROR_CAUSE; it retains ERROR_STATUS RESET_EPOCH ring state and record-header source lifetime counters.

Name: CONTROL.RESET_STREAM_STATE
Semantics: Legal in any state. Clears enable; aborts FILLING as dropped; abandons committed or DMA-owned records; restores ownership; resets sequences; increments epoch and reset-events; invalidates snapshot. Writes while STREAM_RESET_BUSY=1 coalesce and do not create another epoch. After a simultaneous accepted stats clear RESET_EVENTS is 1. With an illegal simultaneous stats reset the reject latches first and this reset completion qualifies its later fatal W1C.
Clock_Domain: axi_aclk transport-reset coordinator with acknowledged transport/source CDC
Clear_Rule: Pulse has no stored state; completion clears STREAM_RESET_BUSY. Statistics and sticky errors otherwise retained; simultaneous accepted statistics clear precedes stream-reset accounting.

Name: CONTROL.RESERVED_ZERO
Semantics: Reserved; reads zero and writes are ignored.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: STATUS.C2H_ENABLED
Semantics: Exact live readback of stored ENABLE_C2H.
Clear_Rule: Clears with ENABLE_C2H clear fatal stream reset or hard reset.

Name: STATUS
Semantics: Live status register; reset value has only RING_EMPTY set.
Clock_Domain: axi_aclk plus synchronized source and ownership state
Clear_Rule: Individual live and sticky-alias clear rules apply.

Name: STATUS.C2H_ACTIVE
Semantics: Set while any slot is not WRITABLE including FILLING COMMITTED DMA_OWNED or RELEASABLE or while the formatter is presenting or holding an AXIS beat.
Clear_Rule: Live; clears when activity drains or resets.

Name: STATUS.RING_EMPTY
Semantics: All four ring slots are WRITABLE.
Clear_Rule: Live; reset restores 1.

Name: STATUS.RING_FULL
Semantics: No ring slot is WRITABLE.
Clear_Rule: Live; reset restores 0.

Name: STATUS.OVERFLOW_SEEN
Semantics: Sticky alias of ERROR_STATUS.RING_OVERFLOW.
Clear_Rule: ERROR_STATUS bit 0 W1C or hard reset.

Name: STATUS.DROP_SEEN
Semantics: Sticky alias of ERROR_STATUS.RECORD_DROP.
Clear_Rule: ERROR_STATUS bit 1 W1C or hard reset.

Name: STATUS.SOURCE_READY
Semantics: Two-flop synchronized source condition init_done && !init_error && local_frontend_released.
Clock_Domain: source domain to two-flop axi_aclk synchronizer
Clear_Rule: Live; source reset disable or initialization failure clears it.

Name: STATUS.SOURCE_LOCKED
Semantics: Set after a successful complete-line marker and length validation; cleared by source reset disable marker error or length error; two-flop synchronized.
Clock_Domain: source domain to two-flop axi_aclk synchronizer
Clear_Rule: Live source clear events or hard reset.

Name: STATUS.STREAM_RESET_BUSY
Semantics: Transport-state reset and CDC acknowledgement are in progress.
Clear_Rule: Clears only when reset actions and all acknowledgements complete.

Name: STATUS.SNAPSHOT_BUSY
Semantics: Snapshot request/acknowledgement and shadow capture are in progress.
Clear_Rule: Clears on completed snapshot or stream/hard reset.

Name: STATUS.SNAPSHOT_VALID
Semantics: Counter shadows contain one completed coherent generation.
Clear_Rule: Invalidated by next accepted snapshot command statistics reset stream reset or hard reset.

Name: STATUS.FATAL_ERROR
Semantics: Live OR of ERROR_STATUS bits 5:3.
Clear_Rule: Clears only when all fatal RW1C bits are legally cleared or by hard reset.

Name: STATUS.RESERVED_ZERO
Semantics: Reserved; reads zero and writes are ignored.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: RECORDS_ATTEMPTED
Semantics: Increments once at the same eligible active-line decision that assigns channel_attempt_sequence before final marker/length validation, whether or not a slot is available or the attempt later commits; wraps modulo 2^32.
Clock_Domain: source/formatter domain via Gray two-flop and request/ack snapshot to axi_aclk
Clear_Rule: FPGA configuration; PCIe/axi hard reset; accepted RESET_C2H_STATS.

Name: RECORDS_COMMITTED
Semantics: Increments once on atomic complete-record slot commit; wraps modulo 2^32.
Clock_Domain: source/formatter domain via Gray two-flop and request/ack snapshot to axi_aclk
Clear_Rule: FPGA configuration; PCIe/axi hard reset; accepted RESET_C2H_STATS.

Name: RECORDS_STREAMED
Semantics: Increments once on beat-511 TVALID && TREADY && TLAST handshake; wraps modulo 2^32.
Clear_Rule: FPGA configuration; PCIe/axi hard reset; accepted RESET_C2H_STATS.

Name: RECORDS_DROPPED
Semantics: Increments once for each consumed attempt that does not commit including ring-full and reset-aborted FILLING attempts; wraps modulo 2^32.
Clock_Domain: source/formatter domain via Gray two-flop and request/ack snapshot to axi_aclk
Clear_Rule: FPGA configuration; PCIe/axi hard reset; accepted RESET_C2H_STATS.

Name: OVERFLOW_COUNT
Semantics: Ring-full subset of RECORDS_DROPPED; one rejected record is one event independent of stall duration; wraps modulo 2^32.
Clock_Domain: source/ring domain via Gray two-flop and request/ack snapshot to axi_aclk
Clear_Rule: FPGA configuration; PCIe/axi hard reset; accepted RESET_C2H_STATS.

Name: SEQUENCE_DISCONTINUITIES
Semantics: Increments once when a streamed same-epoch channel-attempt sequence is not the previous streamed value for that same logical channel plus one modulo 2^32. Each channel has an independent baseline; its first record establishes it. Increments per discontinuous record not per missing value.
Clock_Domain: axi_aclk per-logical-channel continuity tracker and snapshot shadow
Clear_Rule: FPGA configuration; PCIe/axi hard reset; accepted RESET_C2H_STATS.

Name: BEATS_STREAMED_LO
Semantics: Low half of one stable 64-bit counter snapshot; increments counter on every TVALID && TREADY beat; halves may be read in either order.
Clear_Rule: FPGA configuration; PCIe/axi hard reset; accepted RESET_C2H_STATS; 64-bit counter wraps modulo 2^64.

Name: BEATS_STREAMED_HI
Semantics: High half of the same stable 64-bit accepted-beat counter snapshot.
Clear_Rule: FPGA configuration; PCIe/axi hard reset; accepted RESET_C2H_STATS; 64-bit counter wraps modulo 2^64.

Name: LAST_GLOBAL_STREAM_SEQUENCE
Semantics: Global sequence of last record completed by beat-511 handshake. Validity is SNAPSHOT_STATUS bit 2; drops and abandoned records do not update it.
Clear_Rule: Sequence-valid clears on new epoch hard reset stream reset or stats reset; value returns to FFFFFFFF when invalid.

Name: RESET_EPOCH
Semantics: Per-card shared-stream epoch. FPGA configuration establishes zero; each completed host PCIe/AXI or standalone C2H transport-formatter reset advances modulo 2^32. Overlapping causes coalesce. Source-line formatter source or NVP reset alone does not advance it. Read before and after snapshot and retry on change.
Clock_Domain: axi_aclk C2H transport-reset coordinator; configuration-initialized and not reset by axi_aresetn
Clear_Rule: Only FPGA configuration initializes zero; defined synchronized transport-reset completion increments; not cleared by stats reset.

Name: ERROR_STATUS.RING_OVERFLOW
Semantics: Sticky nonfatal ring-full overflow/drop event; same-cycle set wins W1C.
Clock_Domain: source/ring sticky request latch through two-flop request/ack handshake to axi_aclk sticky register
Clear_Rule: W1C any time; same-cycle set wins; source latch clears only after AXI acknowledgement; FPGA configuration or PCIe/axi hard reset.

Name: ERROR_STATUS.RECORD_DROP
Semantics: Sticky nonfatal whole-record drop event; same-cycle set wins W1C.
Clock_Domain: source/formatter sticky request latch through two-flop request/ack handshake to axi_aclk sticky register
Clear_Rule: W1C any time; same-cycle set wins; source latch clears only after AXI acknowledgement; FPGA configuration or PCIe/axi hard reset.

Name: ERROR_STATUS.SEQUENCE_DISCONTINUITY
Semantics: Sticky nonfatal same-epoch channel-attempt sequence discontinuity; same-cycle set wins W1C.
Clear_Rule: W1C any time; same-cycle set wins; FPGA configuration or PCIe/axi hard reset.

Name: ERROR_STATUS.FORMATTER_INTERNAL_ERROR
Semantics: Sticky fatal formatter invariant/internal-state error; ordinary backpressure and defined drops are excluded; same-cycle set wins an otherwise legal W1C.
Clock_Domain: formatter-domain sticky request latch through two-flop request/ack handshake to axi_aclk sticky register
Clear_Rule: W1C only after stream reset while disabled inactive and ring empty; same-cycle set wins; source latch clears only after AXI acknowledgement; FPGA configuration or PCIe/axi hard reset.

Name: ERROR_STATUS.ILLEGAL_OWNERSHIP_STATE
Semantics: Sticky fatal illegal ring ownership encoding or transition; same-cycle set wins an otherwise legal W1C.
Clock_Domain: ring/transport-domain sticky request latch through two-flop request/ack handshake to axi_aclk sticky register
Clear_Rule: W1C only after stream reset while disabled inactive and ring empty; same-cycle set wins; source latch clears only after AXI acknowledgement; FPGA configuration or PCIe/axi hard reset.

Name: ERROR_STATUS.TRANSPORT_ERROR
Semantics: Sticky fatal AXIS transport reset or control protocol error including rejected statistics reset; same-cycle set wins an otherwise legal W1C.
Clear_Rule: W1C only after stream reset while disabled inactive and ring empty; same-cycle set wins; FPGA configuration or PCIe/axi hard reset.

Name: ERROR_STATUS.RESERVED_ZERO
Semantics: Reserved; reads zero and writes are ignored.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: LAST_ERROR_CAUSE
Semantics: Most recent cause: 0 NONE; 1 RING_OVERFLOW; 2 RECORD_DROP; 3 SEQUENCE_DISCONTINUITY; 4 FORMATTER_INTERNAL_ERROR; 5 ILLEGAL_OWNERSHIP_STATE; 6 TRANSPORT_ERROR; 7 STATS_RESET_REJECTED. Same-cycle priority is 7 then 6 then 5 then 4 then 3 then 1 then 2, so specific ring overflow outranks generic drop.
Clear_Rule: Accepted RESET_C2H_STATS clears unless a new accepted error coincides and wins; FPGA configuration or PCIe/axi hard reset dominates. Individual RW1C does not clear it.

Name: SNAPSHOT_COMMAND.CAPTURE
Semantics: Starts explicit coherent counter snapshot only when SNAPSHOT_BUSY=0 and STREAM_RESET_BUSY=0. Otherwise ignored without error or generation change. Stream reset invalidates a pending token; late stale acknowledgements cannot publish VALID.
Clock_Domain: axi_aclk to epoch-qualified acknowledged source-domain snapshot handshakes
Clear_Rule: Pulse has no stored state; completed snapshot or reset releases holds.

Name: SNAPSHOT_COMMAND.RESERVED_ZERO
Semantics: Reserved; reads zero and writes are ignored.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: SNAPSHOT_STATUS.BUSY
Semantics: Snapshot request and source acknowledgements are outstanding.
Clear_Rule: Completed snapshot or stream/hard reset. Reset marks the request token and epoch stale; late acknowledgements are ignored.

Name: SNAPSHOT_STATUS.VALID
Semantics: All counter shadows belong to one completed snapshot generation.
Clear_Rule: Next accepted capture invalidates until completion; stats stream or hard reset invalidates.

Name: SNAPSHOT_STATUS.LAST_GLOBAL_VALID
Semantics: LAST_GLOBAL_STREAM_SEQUENCE shadow is valid for this generation.
Clear_Rule: New epoch stats reset stream reset or hard reset clears validity.

Name: SNAPSHOT_STATUS.LAST_CHANNEL_VALID
Semantics: LAST_CHANNEL_ATTEMPT_SEQUENCE shadow is valid for this generation.
Clear_Rule: New epoch stats reset stream reset or hard reset clears validity.

Name: SNAPSHOT_STATUS.RESERVED_ZERO
Semantics: Reserved; reads zero and writes are ignored.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: SNAPSHOT_GENERATION
Semantics: Increments modulo 2^32 only when a complete snapshot becomes valid. First successful snapshot after FPGA configuration hard reset or accepted stats reset is 1. Stream reset retains generation and the next success increments it.
Clear_Rule: Accepted RESET_C2H_STATS; stream reset invalidates snapshot but retains generation; FPGA configuration or PCIe/axi hard reset clears generation.

Name: RECORDS_ABANDONED
Semantics: Increments once for each committed or DMA-owned complete record discarded by reset before final handshake. FILLING aborts count as dropped instead. Wraps modulo 2^32.
Clear_Rule: FPGA configuration; PCIe/axi hard reset; accepted RESET_C2H_STATS.

Name: RESET_EVENTS
Semantics: Increments once per epoch-advance episode; overlapping or repeated reset causes while busy coalesce. Initial FPGA configuration epoch is excluded. Following hard-reset counter clear the new-epoch release produces value 1. Wraps modulo 2^32.
Clock_Domain: axi_aclk C2H transport-reset coordinator snapshot shadow; coordinator epoch state is not reset by axi_aresetn
Clear_Rule: FPGA configuration; PCIe/axi hard reset clears statistics then synchronized release increments to 1; accepted RESET_C2H_STATS.

Name: LAST_CHANNEL_ATTEMPT_SEQUENCE
Semantics: Per-channel attempt sequence carried by the last completely streamed record. Validity is SNAPSHOT_STATUS bit 3; dropped attempts consume sequence but do not directly update this streamed-last value.
Clock_Domain: axi_aclk final-beat tracker using committed descriptor snapshot shadow
Clear_Rule: Sequence-valid clears on new epoch hard reset stream reset or stats reset; value returns to FFFFFFFF when invalid.

Name: RESERVED_ZERO_GLOBAL
Semantics: Reserved global-page words. Every aligned or unaligned read returns zero; every write is ignored with AXI OKAY.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: RESERVED_ZERO_SCHEDULER
Semantics: Reserved scheduler/throughput page; scheduler is not implemented in G2B.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: RESERVED_ZERO_CHANNEL0
Semantics: Reserved per-channel expansion page; G2B exposes required counters only in the global page.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: RESERVED_ZERO_CHANNEL1
Semantics: Reserved logical-channel-1 page; two-channel implementation is absent.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: RESERVED_ZERO_SELECTION
Semantics: Reserved selection/command page; dynamic channel selection is absent in G2B.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.

Name: RESERVED_ZERO_EXPANSION
Semantics: Reserved future diagnostics error and throughput expansion. No G2B feature is advertised here.
Clear_Rule: Constant zero.
